title: AVERAGE leaves BLANK rows out of the divisor but counts zeros

source.quote: However, when a cell contains a blank, the row is not counted.
source.supports: a zero is in the sum and the divisor, a blank is in neither; the return value is a decimal number

source.quote: AVERAGE ignores blank values. A value of zero is included in the average.

derivation: V[N] holds 5, BLANK, 0, -3, 5, BLANK, 2. Non-blank values: 5, 0, -3, 5, 2. Sum 9, count 5: 9 / 5 = 1.8. Counting all 7 rows would give 1.2857; dropping the zero would give 2.25. The average of an integer column is a decimal number (double).
